request.subject: UNIT:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Change only the colours of the tarp and pennant: the big red tarp over the cargo becomes deep crimson canvas, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, with a thin gold-yellow border and one big gold-yellow cross on top; the red pennant becomes crimson with a gold-yellow tip. Keep the pale wooden hull, oars, ropes, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
